concept: Riddlebox Escape Rooms wraps players in mystery: a deep arcane purple primary evokes locked vaults and clever puzzles, a bright puzzle-orange accent pops like a glowing clue on dark hero scenes, near-black violet-ink text reads crisp on airy off-white backgrounds, and a teal secondary adds a cool, enigmatic counterpoint.
contrastNotes: All WCAG-AA ratios verified. ink on bg 16.99:1 (>=7); ink-soft on bg 8.83:1 (>=4.5); white on primary 10.41:1 (>=4.5); primary-dark on bg 12.15:1 (>=4.5); accent #FF8A2B on near-black #000 8.92:1 (>=3, bright pop on dark heroes). surface-alt #ECE7F4 is a light purple tint near bg with ink on surface-alt 15.14:1 (>=7) for dark text on section backgrounds; ink on surface (white) 18.38:1.
